MAP STATUS — PROCEDURAL RECONSTRUCTION / NOT A SCANNED MATERIAL
Created 2026-11-23. Deterministic script-generated study, separated from source photographs. All maps use the same UV coordinates and resolution. This resolution is authored detail, not recovered source detail.
Uniform frosted transmission study: roughness 0.32, transmission 1, IOR 1.45 and 8 mm pane thickness are authored starting values, not measured. Normal is flat; no invented measured frost pattern. Opacity map remains white: use transmission/refraction, not alpha-cutout transparency.

FILES AND IMPORT
base_color.png: sRGB; interpreted unlit palette, not calibrated albedo.
height_estimated_16bit.png: linear 16-bit, normalized 0-1. Physical height range 0.0 m; authored only.
normal_OpenGL.png: tangent +Y. normal_DirectX.png: same normals with green channel inverted. Use one, never both.
roughness_assumed.png: linear; unmeasured trial values.
metallic_surface.png: linear; outer-surface convention described above.
ambient_occlusion_neutral.png: white fallback, not calculated occlusion.
feature_mask.png: mortar mask for brick; raised-rib mask for cladding; zero for uniform surfaces.
transmission_assumed.png: 1 for glass, 0 otherwise. opacity.png is white; not a glass cutout mask.
UV extent: 0.5 m x 0.5 m, authored. Resolution: 512 x 512.
Use normal OR height-driven bump at first; avoid double-counting the same relief. Start with displacement disabled. The render review uses normal shading only; a side silhouette needs actual geometry.
